strategy: SOL — часовой диапазон, SHORT и LONG 1:1 v33

method.releaseRules: v33 BAG1/3: every definite stop seeds opposite normal plan from former P2/P3 and stop-bar extreme, with next-M5 retest only. Its Fibo base stays fixed; target and midpoint trail before entry. BAG2 cancels other pending plans after confirmed missed pivot retest and strict P3 extension; post-stop plans are exempt. Valid new ordinary P2 retires stale adjacent shadow.
method.execution: Actual v33 Pine source in PineTS 0.12.0, observation plots only
method.newLongStructure: v32: after H1 SHORT-to-LONG switch, former confirmed SHORT low is a validation guard only. On a valid confirmed P2 at/above that low, clear the old origin anchor and use new LONG1–2 Fibo. Strict guard break before entry cancels pending candidate while preserving locked side. Keep guard even if P1 is replaced before P2.
method.renewedLongP1: If LONG P1 is replaced by a higher confirmed swing while waiting for valid P2, clear saved floor 0 and use the new 1–2 structure; ordinary 2–3 reanchoring is allowed only without a confirmed missed pivot and outside post-stop plans. Entry and SL/TP offsets remain unchanged.
method.p2Reversal: Before entry, a P2 break after P3 reverses the pending setup using former P2/P3 Fibo anchors; wait for a separate retest. It overrides the H1 priority lock. Existing positions are unchanged. Simultaneous new P3 and P2 break on historical M5 cancels the setup because order is unknown. The dual-pivot exclusion is not enabled.
method.equalShortLows: After a distinct confirmed return to P1 at the same low, its next strict break resets the SHORT structure. Wait for a new confirmed lower P1 and a new P2; do not seed P3 from the old pair.
method.entryWindow: v31: all new ordinary/reversal searches and retries only on the reference calendar day from15:05 until00:00 Asia/Krasnoyarsk. Pending plans expire at midnight, including live ticks on23:55. Existing entries remain tracked across midnight; target locks further entries; after a stop retry only within the same day.
method.firstM5: Ignore the 15:00–15:05 bar entirely for H1 priority selection (including large or dual-edge exits); choose priority from 15:05 onward. It cannot seed P1 retroactively. The inclusive 0.02 H1 threshold is unchanged.
method.h1BreakThreshold: Price must exceed the H1 edge by at least 0.02 USDT (inclusive); applies to initial priority, first H1 reversal and P1 qualification. P3/M5 breaks and saved LONG origin retain strict prior rules.
method.takeBuffer: Take profit is 0.03 USDT before raw swing P3 (SHORT above, LONG below); entry stays the midpoint of base Fibo stop and raw swing target. Only profitable take levels permit entry.
method.priorityLock: Record initial direction for the H1; first opposite priority locks until new H1; ignore later H1 edge breaks except pending structural P2 reversal and the mandatory opposite plan after a definite stop. A broken saved LONG origin cancels its candidate but preserves locked LONG.
method.calendar: No Saturday/Sunday references or entries in Asia/Krasnoyarsk; weekday entries have no 20:30 cutoff; existing trades retain their exit tracking
method.entry: v33 retest touch; skip new-extreme historical bar
method.swingPair: Keep P1 while skipping adjacent opposite pivot; trail P1 deeper until a separate P2; plateau pivots use their last equal-extreme bar for adjacency
method.longReversal: After a confirmed SHORT lower swing without a P1 break, retain its low as floor 0 for LONG even before its upper P2 confirms; preserve upper P1, skip adjacent low, wait for deeper P2
method.confirmingBarBreakout: Retain P3 extreme on the bar confirming P2; no retroactive entry on that bar
method.fiboReanchor: Only after an unconfirmed partial retest and new P3 may ordinary Fibo reanchor: S=P2-0.25*(P3-P2). A confirmed missed pivot followed by a strict P3 extension cancels other plans under BAG2. Post-stop plans keep their base fixed and are exempt from BAG2. Freeze prices on entry.
method.tightReversalStop: v30: only adjacent-pair reversal exception uses former P3 (Fibo endpoint 0/1) as stop base; actual SL beyond endpoint by 0.03, TP before new swing target by 0.03, entry midway between unbuffered endpoint and raw swing target; actual RR below1 after offsets. Base remains fixed during later partial retest and target extension, subject to BAG2 cancellation for confirmed missed pivots. Post-stop ordinary plans also keep their base fixed.
method.adjacentReversal: Rejected adjacent P1/P2 may seed a reversal-only shadow pattern: break original P1, then cross excluded P2 before entry; Fibo uses original P2/P3; same-bar first P3 requires a later bar to cross P2; a new valid ordinary P2 retires the old shadow; ordinary adjacent-pair entries remain forbidden
method.rejectedRetest: After an adjacent rejected opposite pivot, require a stronger opposite extreme before P2; otherwise keep trailing P1 and clear the threshold when P1 deepens
method.pivotOrdering: The prospective P2 plateau must not already cross P1 before confirmation; otherwise trail a new P1 instead of confirming a stale P2
method.pivotPlateau: Equal adjacent highs/lows are one pivot; confirm only on reversal after the plateau with an opposite-side boundary on its left; use plateau last equal-extreme bar/time
method.originFibo: v32: former SHORT low no longer anchors entered LONG Fibo after valid new P2. Use ordinary1–2, with former low retained as a pre-entry validation guard only.
method.exits: Check from the next M5 after entry; simultaneous TP/SL is ambiguous
method.referenceRollover: Unresolved trade is recorded separately, without a fabricated exit
method.stopOffset: Default 0.03 USDT beyond the Fibo line; entry remains the unbuffered Fibo midpoint
method.rUnits: 1R is actual buffered stop risk; target R is actual reward/risk, not fixed +1; no compounding
